why: `wave/edge` is spawned once, by one objective's completion, is not `respawns_on_rest` and is billed `ordinary`, so no rest re-seats it and nothing seats it twice: every kill of it is already a first kill. `fires: every-kill` there binds to nothing, and the engine refuses it rather than let a judgement stand that no play can observe — naming what the wave would need to come back. It declares no unit: `every-kill` is bound in the primary by `wave/muster`, which every rest re-seats.
